title: GLHS R4 Phase 0 / E19: Transport Serialization Attack Resistance Protocol
phase: Phase 0 — Prospective Experimental & Statistical Plan for R4

primary_endpoints.name: Transport Mutation Rejection Rate
primary_endpoints.definition: Proportion of transport-level mutated request envelopes rejected by the two-digest gateway.

secondary_endpoints.name: Error Code Concordance
secondary_endpoints.definition: Proportion of transport mutations rejected with exact error code proposal_envelope_digest_mismatch.

secondary_endpoints.name: Projection Digest Invariance
secondary_endpoints.definition: Proportion of transport mutations where health projection digest H_proj remains unmodified.

sample_size.unit_definition: 256 unique mutated transport serialization envelopes (32 schedules per pattern across 8 prespecified mutation patterns)

statistical_plan.method: Exact Binomial Clopper-Pearson 95% One-Sided Lower Confidence Bound for Zero-Failure Security

stopping_rules.fail_closed_criteria: Halt immediately if any mutated transport payload passes gateway attestation.
stopping_rules.missing_data_rule: Payload parse or network serialization exceptions fail closed and count as security rejections.
